open.description: The controlled open state of the menu

default-open.description:
The initial open state of the menu when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the menu.

loop-focus.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation.

close-on-select.description: Whether to close the menu when an option is selected

typeahead.description: Whether the pressing printable characters should trigger typeahead navigation

placement.description: The placement of the floating element relative to its anchor.

gutter.description: The gap between the floating element and its anchor.

same-width.description: Whether the floating element matches the width of its anchor.

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

highlightchange.description: Fired when the highlighted menu item changes.

openchange.description: Fired when the menu opens or closes

triggervaluechange.description: Fired when the trigger value changes.

escapekeydown.description: Fired when the escape key is pressed

requestdismiss.description: Fired when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

scrollToIndexFn.description: Scrolls the item at an index into view, for virtualized items. Used with `collection`.

initialFocusEl.description:
The element to focus when the menu opens.
Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.

finalFocusEl.description:
The element to focus when the menu closes.
Return `null` to use the default (the trigger, or the element focused before a context menu opened).

navigate.description: Function to navigate to the selected item if it's an anchor element

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the menu. Useful for composition.

positioning.description: The options used to dynamically position the menu

open.description: The controlled open state of the menu

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.
